record.title: JST EHR-3 ('EHR-03' in ROBOTIS' manual) — 3-circuit EH 2.5 mm pitch cable housing, the plug on both ends of every DYNAMIXEL X3P lead
record.origin_why: Every dimension is read off JST's EH CONNECTOR datasheet eEH.pdf p.3 'Housing' (fetched jst-mfg.com 2026-09-04, sha256 9e35874b…, vendored at iterations/v0.0.1/docs/fetched/eEH.pdf); the part number comes from ROBOTIS e-Manual XL330-M288-T §Connector Information 'Housing JST EHR-03'. Not `standard` (no standard fixes an EH), not `measured` (no instrument has touched one here).
record.mpn_note: JST's table prints EHR-3; ROBOTIS prints EHR-03. Same part — JST's p.6 'Model number allocation' shows EH R - <circuits> with no zero padding.
record.lifecycle_why: eEH.pdf carries no lifecycle statement; no distributor page fetched for this member.
record.why: ENVELOPE AND CONTACT ROW ARE VENDOR-DRAWN AND BUILD: 9.5000 x 3.8000 x 6.5000 with contacts at x -2.5000 / 0.0000 / +2.5000 and a 0.6 lock rib, every figure from eEH.pdf p.3. CANNOT DETERMINE rather than PASS because: (1) the latch window, polarising key and the contact cavity shape are simplified (cavities modelled 1.8 square as a stated modelling clearance, not a drawing figure); (2) no vendor STEP exists for the EHR housing on the workshop shelf to corroborate against (part:conn-jst-eh-2.5mm carries headers only), so the envelope is corroborated by nothing but the drawing itself; (3) mass is CANNOT DETERMINE — no vendor figure; (4) no offer fetched for this member. What settles it: a housing STEP or calipers, a scale, a distributor page. 'Contacts Sold Separately': three part:jst-seh-001t-p0.6 per housing.
